info.title: Elitea AI Platform
info.description: REST API for the Elitea AI Platform. Provides programmatic access to project-scoped resources including agents, pipelines, toolkits, conversations, MCP integrations, settings, analytics, and runtime utilities. Supports the full agent/pipeline lifecycle — create, configure, execute, publish, fork, import, and export. All resources are scoped to a project. Most endpoints require Bearer token authentication and role-based permissions.

get.name: Get Project Analytics Overview
get.description: Returns project-level AI adoption KPIs, event type breakdown, top active users, daily activity trend, tool usage, model usage, agent activity, chat session stats, and per-event-type health metrics.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Start datetime (ISO 8601). Defaults to 7 days ago.

get.name: Get Agent Analytics Detail
get.description: Returns KPIs, per-user breakdown, tool usage, and daily activity for a single agent (application) identified by entity_id.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Start datetime (ISO 8601). Defaults to 7 days ago.

404.description: No data found for this agent

get.name: List Agent Analytics
get.description: Returns paginated agent/application usage statistics with optional date filtering, search by name, sorting, and a daily chat-message trend.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Start datetime (ISO 8601). Defaults to 7 days ago.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Filter by agent name (case-insensitive partial match).

get.name: Get Tool Analytics Detail
get.description: Returns KPIs, per-user breakdown, associated agents, and daily usage trend for a single tool identified by tool_name.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Start datetime (ISO 8601). Defaults to 7 days ago.

404.description: No data found for this tool

get.name: List Tool Analytics
get.description: Returns paginated tool usage statistics with optional date filtering, search by tool name, and sorting.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Start datetime (ISO 8601). Defaults to 7 days ago.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Filter by tool name (case-insensitive partial match).

get.name: Get User Analytics Detail
get.description: Returns KPIs, model usage, tool usage, agent usage, and daily activity breakdown for a single user identified by user_id.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Start datetime (ISO 8601). Defaults to 7 days ago.

404.description: No data found for this user

get.name: List User Analytics
get.description: Returns paginated user activity statistics broken down by LLM calls, tool runs, agent interactions, and chat events, with sorting and search.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Start datetime (ISO 8601). Defaults to 7 days ago.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Filter by user email (case-insensitive partial match).

get.name: Get agent or pipeline details
get.description: Returns the full details of the specified agent or pipeline. If version_name is provided, that specific version is returned. If omitted, the active default version is returned.

put.name: Update an agent or pipeline
put.description: Updates the agent or pipeline metadata and its active version in a single request. The version referenced in the request body must match the agent or pipeline in the path.

delete.name: Delete an agent or pipeline
delete.description: Permanently deletes the agent or pipeline and all its versions. This action is irreversible.

get.name: List agents and pipelines
get.description: Returns a paginated list of agents and pipelines in the project. Supports filtering by tags, author, status, type, and free-text search.

post.name: Create an agent or pipeline
post.description: Creates a new agent or pipeline with an initial (base) version. The request must include agent or pipeline metadata and at least one version definition.

post.name: Create Attachments
post.description: Upload file attachments to a conversation.

delete.name: Delete Attachments
delete.description: Delete one or more attachments from a conversation and optionally keep files in storage.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Filename or filepath to delete. Can be provided multiple times.

parameters.name: keep_in_storage
parameters.description: If true, keep files in bucket and remove only DB attachment records.

get.name: Get Author Profile
get.description: Return author profile details and aggregated stats.

get.name: Get Canvas
get.description: Get canvas details including versions and content.

get.name: List Canvases
get.description: Get list of canvas items with pagination and sorting.

post.name: Create Canvas
post.description: Create a new canvas from a message item.

get.name: Get Conversation Context Analytics
get.description: Returns context utilisation analytics for a conversation: token counts, context window usage percentage, active context strategy, and message breakdown.

put.name: Update Context Strategy
put.description: Update context strategy settings for a conversation.

get.name: Get Conversation

put.name: Update Conversation

patch.name: Configure Participant

parameters.name: as_file

parameters.name: follow_version_ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated version IDs to follow during export.

get.name: List Folders and Conversations

parameters.name: date_group

post.name: Create Folder

delete.name: Delete Folder
delete.description: Delete a folder and unassign conversations from it.

post.name: MCP OAuth DCR Proxy
post.description: Proxy RFC 7591 Dynamic Client Registration requests to OAuth servers to avoid CORS issues.

post.name: MCP OAuth Token Proxy
post.description: Proxy OAuth token exchange (authorization_code or refresh_token grant) to avoid CORS issues. Optionally fetches credentials from a stored toolkit.

post.name: MCP Sync Tools
post.description: Discover and sync available tools from a remote MCP server. Supports async mode via Socket.IO.

parameters.name: await_response
parameters.description: Wait for the result synchronously (default: true).

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Timeout in seconds (default: 120 for sync, -1 for async).

delete.name: Delete Message

delete.name: Delete All Messages

get.name: Get Participant

delete.name: Remove Participant

post.name: Add Participants

post.name: LLM Predict

get.name: Get Project User Activity (Admin)
get.description: Admin-only endpoint. Returns distinct users with event counts for a given project, optionally filtered by date range.

post.name: Publish an agent version to Agent Studio
post.description: Publishes an agent version to Agent Studio, making it available to the broader community. Requires the version to pass pre-publish validation. Run /publish_validate first to check readiness and receive a validation_token that skips re-validation on publish. Applicable to agents only - pipelines cannot be published.

post.name: Validate an agent version before publishing
post.description: Runs pre-publish checks on the agent version before it is submitted to Agent Studio. Returns a validation_token on success that can be passed to /publish to skip re-validation. Applicable to agents only.

post.name: Regenerate Message
post.description: Regenerate assistant response for a message group.
